mechanism.claim: A high-variation completed eight-hour BTC block with an unusually high Higuchi fractal dimension spent its displacement on a rough multi-scale path rather than coherent price discovery. When the full block and final two hours agree, fade that fragile endpoint displacement for eight hours.
mechanism.side: opposite the common strict sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVHRR estimates graph-length scaling directly from all 480 completed log-price levels at integer lags 1 through 8. Rescaled range scales cumulative demeaned return ranges across disjoint windows; time-price fit measures one linear trend; recurrence determinism counts diagonal recurrences; variance ratio compares aggregated return variance. HVHRR uses no flow, volume, funding, OI, cross-assets, prior events, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal variation tail selects volatile blocks while the roughness tail isolates multi-scale path fragmentation whose endpoint is least likely to represent acceptance
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC graph-roughness onsets with an eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.log_price_path: natural logarithm of all 480 completed one-minute closes
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute close-to-close returns), strict positive
features.higuchi_length: for each integer lag k=1..8, mean normalized absolute graph length over offsets m=0..k-1; every offset must contain at least two increments and finite positive length
features.higuchi_dimension: OLS slope of log(mean graph length) on log(1/k) for k=1..8
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.roughness_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h) over final two hours
features.direction_confirmation: block and late returns have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
